note: Round-27 fixes. Cron: the scheduler thread's runtime is built before the thread starts, so a build failure releases the job claims for a retry (it used to panic on the new thread). f32 range bounds on a type alias round inward like the integer ones (16777217 and 0.09999999701 no longer admit the neighbour across the bound). JNI optional knobs saturate a non-negative value that does not fit usize instead of dropping it. A finished dispatch fails its unread streaming body at once, without waiting for a producer slot. Docs: vespera_dispatch_into size-rule precedence, vespera_dispatch_async callback wording, wire hoist comments, the async completion retry limit.
